Container.Name: breakfix-triage
Container.Overview: Break-fix operations platform for NYC DOE device repair lifecycle management. Replaces a legacy Google Sheets + Apps Script workflow with a PostgreSQL-backed Next.js application. Requires a running breakfix-postgres container reachable on the Unraid host IP. Database migrations and the idempotent bootstrap script run automatically on container start.
Container.Requires: The breakfix-postgres container must be running and its 5432 port must be reachable on the Unraid host IP (e.g. 192.168.1.19:5432). The DATABASE_URL below must match the credentials on breakfix-postgres.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port the Next.js app listens on. Default is 3005. Keep the container side at 3000.

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: Full Postgres connection string. Use the Unraid host IP (192.168.1.19) as the hostname. Replace REPLACE_ME with the password you set on breakfix-postgres.

Config.Name: NEXTAUTH_URL
Config.Description: URL the browser uses to reach this app. Use your Unraid tower IP and the host port you published.

Config.Name: NEXTAUTH_SECRET
Config.Description: Random string used to sign session tokens. Generate once with: openssl rand -base64 32

Config.Name: BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL
Config.Description: Email address for the initial admin user. Used only when the database has zero users (first boot). Ignored on subsequent restarts.

Config.Name: BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Password for the initial admin user. Must be 8+ characters. Used only when the database has zero users. Leave blank if you plan to create users manually later.

Config.Name: BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_NAME
Config.Description: Display name for the initial admin user.

Config.Name: ROUTE_OPTIMIZER
Config.Description: Route optimizer backend. Options: nearest-neighbor (default, no API key) or google-routes (Phase 4).

Config.Name: NOTIFICATION_TRANSPORT
Config.Description: Notification delivery transport. Options: stdout (default), smtp, gmail, apps-script.

Config.Name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Google Workspace OAuth client ID (optional, for SSO in Phase 1).

Config.Name: GOOGLE_ROUTES_API_KEY
Config.Description: Google Routes API key (optional, for Phase 4 route optimization).

Config.Name: Attachments
Config.Description: Where uploaded ticket photos and PDFs are stored. Bind-mount to appdata so uploads survive container rebuilds. Phase 6.

Config.Name: READ_ONLY_MODE
Config.Description: Set to 'true' to reject all writes at the middleware layer during a cutover window. An amber banner will appear on every page.
